biggest_catch: One-time $20 membership fee plus $5 share minimum to join; the $250 deposit and 15 debit-card transactions must be completed in the first 60 days and the $200 only pays within 60 days after all requirements are met.
catches: One-time $20 membership fee to join Horizon Credit Union (ages 18+), plus a $5 Value Shares Savings minimum balance.
Must be 18 or older at time of application; verification of residence location required upon membership application.
Promotion only for those who don't currently have a Horizon checking account and haven't had one in the last five years.
One offer per household; not eligible for Youth or Business accounts.

Must complete all of the following within the first 60 days of account opening: fund the account with at least $250 within 5 business days; complete at least 15 debit card transactions; accept electronic statement delivery in Horizon online banking; keep the account open and in good standing for 60 days.
Horizon Credit Union reserves the right to modify or cancel the offer at any time without prior notice — no stated expiry date.
Account must be open at the time the $200 bonus is deposited (within 60 days after all qualifications are met).
Membership eligibility is geo-restricted: Eastern Washington, select Idaho and Montana counties, and Eastern Oregon counties only.
Bonus is considered taxable income; the recipient is responsible for all taxes.
OAC (on approved credit) — new account is subject to approval.

steps: Join Horizon Credit Union (18+, eligible residence, one-time $20 membership fee plus $5 Value Shares savings minimum) and open a new Horizon checking account using promo code get200.
Fund the new checking account with a minimum deposit of $250 within 5 business days of account opening.
Accept and agree to electronic statement delivery within Horizon's online banking platform.
Complete at least 15 debit card transactions within 60 days of the account open date and keep the account open and in good standing for 60 days.
Horizon makes a one-time $200 deposit into the qualifying account within 60 days of all qualifications being met; the account must be open at payout.
timing: Bonus is deposited within 60 days after all qualifications are met. All qualifications must be completed within the first 60 days of account opening ($250 funding within 5 business days; 15 debit transactions within 60 days; eStatements; 60 days in good standing).
